entities.summary: Jimmy Choo Yeang Keat is a Malaysian fashion designer based in the United Kingdom. He co-founded Jimmy Choo Ltd, which became known for its handmade women's shoes. Jimmy Choo was a performers & entertainers from George Town (b. 1948-11-15, George Town). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
